title: Choose FAZAB’s new visual world
question: The lead direction turns concept-to-completion into one continuous drawing. Keep it, take the field-register alternative, or steer the roll.

options.label: The Light Table
options.lineage: architectural tracing film, drawing registers, and coordinated overlays
options.thesis: Four disciplines arrive as separate layers, then align into one accountable line from concept to completion.
options.viewport: A pale drawing field carries an off-centre title at building scale, a narrow photographic site strip, and four translucent phase layers crossing one fixed datum line; the enquiry action sits beside the completed coordinate.
options.risk: The technical language must stay legible and human or it can feel like a drawing tool rather than a trusted practice.

raised.raise: The active delivery phase is unmistakably illuminated while inactive layers recede.
Line frequency does real work, tightening only where coordination and action matter.
Empty stages remain deliberately visible, making progress and absence equally clear.
One unbroken path carries the visitor from first idea to final handover.

options.label: The Site Register
options.lineage: survey field books, site diaries, and numbered inspection records
options.thesis: FAZAB becomes the calm record of decisions, coordinates, milestones, and accountable delivery.
options.viewport: A large numbered register entry opens the site: location and date in the margin, one decisive construction image, a precise statement, and the next inspection point as the primary action.
options.risk: Field-note aesthetics are familiar in architecture portfolios and need exceptional composition to avoid becoming predictable editorial minimalism.

options.label: Measured Frequency
options.lineage: Bridget Riley’s monochrome wave rooms translated into coordinated building systems
options.thesis: Four line fields converge as the visitor moves, turning integration into an optical fact rather than a claim.
options.viewport: A sparse title sits clear of a full-height line field whose four frequencies settle into one band beside the enquiry action.
options.case: Strong audience identification and unforgettable motion; the integration story is less immediately literal than the light table.
options.risk: Optical vibration can become tiring and must collapse gracefully for reduced motion and small screens.

options.label: Vertical Programme
options.lineage: stacked Tokyo signboard alleys translated into a floor-by-floor delivery index
options.thesis: Each discipline occupies a lit floor in one vertical project stack.
options.viewport: A building-height service index glows beside a restrained project statement.
options.case: The navigation model is clear, but the nightlife reference does not identify FAZAB’s audience.
options.kept: Active and inactive stages now read at a glance in the lead direction.
options.risk: Its urban-night character conflicts with FAZAB’s calm professional authority.

options.label: Delivery Instrument
options.lineage: seven-segment instruments and fixed-cell status displays
options.thesis: The project lifecycle is a fixed instrument whose state changes without moving the underlying structure.
options.viewport: The year, four disciplines, and live phase occupy a rigid measurement panel.
options.case: Progress is legible, but the electronic idiom weakens audience identification.
options.kept: Inactive states are designed with the same care as active content.
options.risk: It can imply infrastructure monitoring rather than design and construction expertise.

options.label: Tender Terminal
options.lineage: ANSI bulletin boards translated into a keyboard-first tender index
options.thesis: Every capability and project becomes a numbered, instantly reachable record.
options.viewport: An 80-column practice index exposes services and projects as numbered exits.
options.case: The information structure is robust, but the nostalgia adds friction to a trust decision.
options.kept: Every important destination remains reachable by clear text and keyboard.
options.risk: The terminal voice is too informal for high-stakes procurement.

options.label: One Continuous Run
options.lineage: a hand-bent neon circuit translated into one accountable delivery path
options.thesis: A single unbroken line passes through design, technical work, construction, and handover.
options.viewport: The brand promise follows a single traced path through four named junctions.
options.case: The mechanism is clear, but literal glow would pull the brand toward entertainment.
options.kept: The lead direction now owns one unbroken path from concept to completion.
options.risk: Neon is too expressive for the required quiet authority.

options.label: Adaptive Surface
options.lineage: chromatophore skin translated into responsive project-state layers
options.thesis: The same system changes density and emphasis to fit each stage and screen.
options.viewport: A pale field develops four coordinated pigment bands as the project story advances.
options.case: Adaptation is powerful, but the biological metaphor obscures the practice’s technical credibility.
options.kept: The lead system changes density without losing its identity on smaller screens.
options.risk: The organic motion is culturally distant from FAZAB’s operating world.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark luxury architecture portfolio with full-bleed photography, bronze accents, and serif headlines.
canonCard.viewport: A conventional full-bleed project image carries a large promise, restrained navigation, and two CTAs.
canonCard.risk: Immediately legible, but visually interchangeable with many architecture and property websites.
